name: pageink-extension
description: The PageInk browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.

scripts.build:all: wxt build && wxt build -b edge && wxt build -b firefox && wxt build -b safari
scripts.zip: wxt zip && wxt zip -b edge && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: wxt build -b firefox && npx -y -p node@22 -- node node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js lint --source-dir .output/firefox-mv3
scripts.test: wxt build && wxt build -b edge && wxt build -b firefox && wxt build -b safari && INK_NO_LOCAL_IDS=1 wxt build --mode bench && INK_CLOUD_FAKE=1 wxt build && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: INK_NO_LOCAL_IDS=1 wxt build && INK_NO_LOCAL_IDS=1 wxt build --mode bench && INK_CLOUD_FAKE=1 wxt build && playwright test
